title: Odisha Mining & Infrastructure International Expo 2027 Brochure Unveiled
excerpt: A significant milestone for Futurex Group as the Hon'ble Deputy Chief Minister of Odisha unveils the brochure of the fifth edition.
paragraphs: We are delighted to share the media coverage of the brochure unveiling of Odisha Mining & Infrastructure International Expo, marking an important milestone in our journey towards bringing together the mining, infrastructure and industrial sectors on one platform.
The brochure was unveiled by the Hon'ble Deputy Chief Minister of Odisha, Shri Kanak Vardhan Singh Deo, in the distinguished presence of leading industry personalities.

We sincerely appreciate the recognition and support as we continue working towards creating a dynamic platform for industry collaboration, technological innovation, business opportunities and investment.
The fifth edition is scheduled for 7–10 January 2027 at Baramunda Exhibition Ground, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
The exhibition aims to bring together companies, industry experts and stakeholders from India and abroad, showcasing Odisha's potential in mining, minerals, infrastructure and industrial development.
A proud moment for Futurex Group and a significant step towards strengthening Odisha's position as a leading industrial and investment destination.
dignitaries: Shri Kanak Vardhan Singh Deo — Hon'ble Deputy Chief Minister of Odisha
Swami Prem Anveshi — CMD, Futurex Group
Shri Gajanan S. Kale — CEO, TP Central Odisha Distribution Limited and Chief, Odisha Distribution Business, Tata Power
Shri Tapan Kumar Chand — Director, Vedanta Group and Former CMD, NALCO
Shri Sudhanshu Sekhar — Prominent Business Personality of Odisha
